subject: Novasight on‑prem: sudden p95 latency & error-rate spike — need exec priority
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@novasight.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference>; Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>, procurement@novasight.ai
Date: Fri, 22 Jun 2028 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Production on‑prem cluster - sudden p95 and 5xx increase

Team —

We shipped the v2.1.4 model bundle to our on‑prem cluster last night (private deployment, us‑west) and since ~01:30 UTC were seeing a sustained p95 increase from ~420ms to ~1.6s and a 5xx spike (mostly 502/504) across two of our edge shards. Requesting an urgent triage. Impact: several RL evaluation jobs are timing out and our customer QA is blocked.

Quick details:
- Host footprint: 4x A40 nodes, Kubernetes 1.28, kernel 5.10
- Redwood runtime: 1.12.3 (pinned)
- Failure pattern: p95 latency grows with sustained small bursts (10–30 rps), then requests start 502ing after KV cache miss bursts
- Attachments: performance_log_20280622.tar.gz (logs + perf counters), nova_kpi_screenshot.png

Can you triage and confirm if this is a runtime regression, customer misconfig, or something environmental on our side? Were preparing to escalate internally if this persists.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Platform Reliability
Novasight
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@novasight.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference>; Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 22 Jun 2028 08:29:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production on‑prem cluster - sudden p95 and 5xx increase

Samira —

Thanks for the signal and the artifacts. Naomi and Olga are looped in and well take first pass triage immediately.
Next steps (proposed):
1) Naomi to run targeted perf counters and KV cache hot‑key sweep against the provided logs. Well check if recent kernel upgrades correlate to the drop.
2) Olga to validate runtime config (batching, tokenization hooks, quantized path) and confirm model variant compatibility.
3) Schedule 30m call within the hour — please share an availability window.

If we confirm this affects warm prefixed requests well push a temporary routing fallback to a compatible model variant while we investigate.

S — Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Enterprise 
Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference>; Samira Khan <samira.k@novasight.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 22 Jun 2028 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production on‑prem cluster - sudden p95 and 5xx increase

Folks —

I pulled the logs in performance_log_20280622.tar.gz. Quick observations:
- KV cache churn: elevated evictions starting 2028‑06‑22T01:24:xxZ that correlate with the first p95 step change. Estimated miss amplification for affected prefixes ~x3.
- GC pattern: node‑level GC spikes on two pods (node‑a03, node‑a04) around the same time; CPU utilization for those pods jumps 70->95% for short intervals.
- Transport errors: a small but rising set of upstream 502s corresponding to backend connection resets; likely symptom not root cause.

Immediate mitigations I recommend we try (non‑disruptive):
A) Reduce request batching to avoid oversized packed tensors (temporarily set batch_size_soft_limit = 0.6x)
B) Increase KV cache size on the two affected pods by 25% and pin hot prefixes for 10m to measure effect
C) If latency remains, fallback routing to the v2.1.2 compatible variant (lower memory footprint) for the blue shard only

I can run A+B now if Novasight approves — they require a short downtime window for the pinned change (~1m to warm).

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@novasight.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference>; Samira Khan <samira.k@novasight.ai>

Subject: Re: Production on‑prem cluster - sudden p95 and 5xx increase

Thanks for the quick responses. We are under time pressure — this regression is blocking two high‑priority demos scheduled Monday. Evan chording in because our VP wants executive visibility; shes asking for a short briefing note (what happened, impact, immediate mitigation, next‑steps and ETA to full remediation).

Can Redwood prepare an executive one‑pager and a short remediation timeline by EOD PST? Were also open to a joint exec sync if that helps.

Evan Brooks
Director of Product Ops
Novasight
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference>; Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>; Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.k@novasight.ai>; Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@novasight.ai>
Date: Sat, 23 Jun 2028 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production on‑prem cluster - sudden p95 and 5xx increase

Team — closing loop here with the exec‑level ask and proposed plan. Quoting the chain below for context.

Executive brief (one‑pager summary):
- What happened: After a scheduled model bundle update (v2.1.4) to Novasights on‑prem cluster, two edge shards experienced increased KV cache churn and transient GC spikes leading to p95 latency rising ~4x and downstream 502/504 errors.
- Impact: Customer evaluation and demo flows impacted; estimated ~12% of requests in the window returned 5xx.
- Immediate mitigation (implemented 2028‑06‑23T01:15Z): 
   * Naomi reduced soft batching limit and increased KV cache allocation for affected pods (A+B). Measured p95 improvement from 1.6s -> ~520ms over 20m.
   * Olga validated model path and confirmed no incompatibility in quantized kernels — root cause likely runtime memory pressure and hot‑key eviction amplification.
   * Routing fallback queued — will be enacted only if p95 regresses back above 800ms.
- Next steps (owner & ETA):
   1) Run extended soak with hot prefix pinning for 48h (Naomi) — ETA 48h
   2) Produce a targeted runtime patch to improve cache eviction heuristics (Engineering / Runtime team) — ETA 10 business days
   3) Scheduler change: add preflight check for KV allocation vs. model memory footprint during bundle rollout (Product/Deploy) — ETA 15 business days

Attached: runbook_draft.pdf (naomis checklist), performance_log_20280622.tar.gz (raw), nova_kpi_screenshot.png

As requested, Ill draft a 1‑page Exec note for Novasights VP and copy our customer success director. Marissa — can you help finalize for distribution?

Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
